book.name: Romans
book.title: Rome Paul Ana Fef Rome Isah

content: God Ana Bosunusunub
Jew orot inamamatar boro Ufun Sabuw inanatabirih? Naatu a’ar kanabin hina’a’afuw ana gewasin i boro men tomar inab?
Ef tata’ane etei i gewasih, wantoro’ot God ana tur i Jew sabuw hitutumih hitih.
Baise sabuw afa men hibitumitum isan, kwanotanot God ana omatanen isan boro men nabosunusunub?
En anababatun! God ana tur i mar etei turobe, baise sabuw i baifuwenayah. Buk Atamaninamaim iti na’atube hikirum,

content.text: “Tur awamaim etitit i mar etei asinafumaim initurobe,

content: Baise it ata sinaf kakafihimaim God ana sinaf gewasin bebeyan natit sabuw hina’i’itin ana veya, it boro mi’itube tanao? God baifuwenamaim yan so’ar baimakiy ebitit? it i anababatun taikoko’aw tao kwanekwan.
Nati tur i men turobe tao’omih, anayabin sinaf nati na’atube nama’am, God boro mi’itube tafaram ana sabuw nibatiyih?
Orot babin ta boro nagam nao, “Ayu i men bosunusunubayan, baise au bowabowamaim turobe God nowan tit irerereb sabuw hi’itin God hifai tebobora’ara’ah, aisim God ayu kakafu rouw eo ekukusairu?”
Naatu iban boro kwanao maiye, kakafin tanasinaf, saise sinaf gewasin boro ine natit. Sabuw afa ayu iti na’atube o hirouw higam tiu’uwu, God nati sabuw boro baimakiy nitih.
Men Yait Ta Gewasin
Iti sawar ana an i abisa? It Jew ata gewasin i ra’at Eteni Sabuw tanatabirih? En anababatun! Jew sabuw naatu Eteni Sabuw etei i bowabow kakafin ana fair babanamaim tama’am.
Buk Atamaninamaim iti na’atube hikirum,

content.text: “Orot babin men yait ta ana ef mutufurin, men kafa’imo orot ta’imon;
Men yait ta ana not rerekabin,
men kafa’imo yait ta gewasin esisinaf,
Sikah dub i tahahab sabuw tetotonan,
ufurihimaim kok tuwamorob awakirurin awan karatan.”
“Awah i orarafen awan karatan naatu tenakuyakuy.”
“Iti sabuw umah i rara awan karatan.
Menamaim tenan ma kakaf naatu gurugurusen mar etei imaim emamatar,
Naatu tufuwamaim ma ana ef i men hiso’ob.
Naatu God matanamaim men kafa’imo tibibiruw.”

content: Imih it ata so’obamaim ofafar hikikirum i sabuw iyab ofafar babanamaim tema’am isah, saise awah etei nabofafaren, naatu tafaram wanawanan sabuw etei nabow nan God ana baibatiyenamaim hinatit.
Isan imih God boro men sabuw ofafar tebobosiyasiyar imaim hai ef mutufurin narouw nabowamih, ofafar i orot babin ana bowabow kakafin botait ebirerereb.
Baise boun God sabuw yamutufurih isan ana ef i boubun botawiy. Moses naatu dinab oro’orot nati isan i ofafaramaim hio’orereb tanowar, men ofafar tanabi’ufununimaim nabuwitamih.
It yamutufuren boubun Godane enan i sabuw iyab Jesu Keriso tibitumitum imaim enan, naatu God matanamaim it etei ata’itinin i men tata’amih.
Anayabin sabuw etei bowabow kakafin hisinaf naatu God ana gewasin bain isan umah kabom.
Baise manaw kabeber God ana siwar na’atube Jesu Keriso wanawananamaim na it ata kakafihine tubunit
botaitit tatit.

Bowabow kakafin notawiyen isan God Keriso biyan siboromih yai, ana rara suwa re saise baitumatumamaim tanan biyan tanatit. Sawar iti na’atube sinaf saise bebeyan ti’obaiyit i ana ef i mutufurin. Anayabin I ana yatenub kakafiyin imaim bowabow kakafih marasika tasisinaf isubun rabon.
Naatu iti boun it ata veya’amaim i turobe ebi’obaiyit i ana ef mutufurin. Imih i karam sabuw iyab Jesu tibitumitum boro nafufunih gewas nayamutufurih.
Isan imih it boro abisa isan tanaora’ara’at? Ofafar tabobosiyasiyar isan tarara’at? En anababatun! Baise baitumatum isan i tarara’at.
Anayabin sabuw iyab tibitumatum i hai ef mutufurin rouw ebowabow men ofafaramih.
Imih kwanotanot God i Jew sabuw akisih hai God? Ai kwanotanot Ufun Sabuw auman hai God? Baise anao kwananowar, iti God i Ufun Sabuw auman hai God.
Kwanaso’ob God i ta’imon men rou’ab, imih sabuw iyab hai ar kanabih hi’afuw o men hi’afuw etei i baitumatum ta’imonamaim hiyawas.
Kwanotanot iti baitumatumamaim aki ofafar abobosa’ir? En anababatun, aki i ofafar aiwa’an tit ana efan bai ebirerereb.
